notes: All records require independent fee, geography, and substantive AI policy review before inclusion. JOSS explicitly permits most submission uses including software and paper authoring subject to disclosure and human review: https://joss.readthedocs.io/en/latest/policies.html. E-Informatica asks authors to disclose generative AI in manuscript preparation, but that alone does not establish all three required permissions: https://www.e-informatyka.pl/einformatica/authors-guide/paper-requirements-and-recommendations/. Other AI policies remain unverified.
The Art, Science, and Engineering of Programming expects presentation at partnering conferences; do not assume a free route before checking registration and alternatives.

Global baseline names also present: Journal of Object Technology, e-Informatica Software Engineering Journal, Journal of Statistical Software, Journal of Open Source Software, Logical Methods in Computer Science. Kept because they are relevant to the new software-engineering membership and deduplication must preserve reviewed memberships.
JFP moved from Cambridge to its own charity on Episciences in 2026; do not rely on old publisher terms.
